entry.title: New: dashr#dashr
entry.summary: RLM mode for dsh: recursive sub-agents via a unified rlm() function — spawn, await, and chain child agents as first-class Python calls. Adds a persistent IPython kernel with tools.* bindings and context-as-variable. Exact install spec: dsh-rlm-mode. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
